'''Velso''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was stationed at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
